title: Add Locale('he') RTL coverage for GoalSetupForm/GoalSetupScreen and StudyDaysReadOnly
why: _buildGoalFormHarness/_buildGoalScreenHarness already accept a `locale` parameter, but of the ~15 tests across groups D-I (goal-type switching, deadline mode, pace mode with Amudim/Dafim/Perakim/Pesukim unit-picker pills, submission, screen wrapper) not one passes Locale('he') — the single Hebrew test in this 1407-line file (line 401) covers only the unrelated Tutor PIN dialog. Likewise StudyDaysReadOnly (tests 10-14) has no RTL variant even though its sibling StudyDaysEditable does (test #9). TQ-3 exists precisely because 'RTL-only layout and overflow bugs—which this app ships fixes for every audit wave—are invisible to LTR-only tests', and GoalSetupForm's slider + segmented unit-picker pills are exactly the kind of layout most prone to RTL overflow.
recommendation: Add at least one Locale('he') smoke test per screen (mirroring the existing StudyDaysEditable/ContentHierarchyScreen/TutorPinVerificationDialog pattern already in this batch) asserting no overflow/crash for GoalSetupForm (pace mode with a unit picker) and for StudyDaysReadOnly.
acceptance_criteria: at least one testWidgets case per screen pumps with locale: const Locale('he') and asserts find.byType(Scaffold) (or equivalent) renders without a FlutterError/overflow

corrections: learning_tracker/test/features/scheduler/widgets/goal_setup_screen_test.dart:471-497 runs `for (final locale in const [Locale('en'), Locale('he')])` x textScale [1.0,1.3] asserting GoalSetupScreen's pace-mode Bavli unit-picker labels never truncate — this already covers the GoalSetupForm/pace/unit-picker RTL risk the finding claims is untested. StudyDaysReadOnly (line 511) remains genuinely uncovered.
